scope: Existing browser checks that failed on the new build were rerun unchanged on the previous commit, from a detached worktree served locally with the same Chrome and Puppeteer. Disposable profiles; no score posted.

results.cause: The desktop run saves a shift, so Play becomes Continue; the phone step waited 30 s for a briefing that Continue never opens.
It expected the phrase 'not used in this build', removed when the Atlas media became runtime assets.
It read the Settings status before the asynchronous local reset finished.
Its unarmed practice walk to the Director sometimes loses on aisle 10 before the boss-bar check.

fix: Commit cc9bc12 repairs the four scripts without changing game code. One further presentation failure was real: the first perspective framing placed the Director above the boss bar's clamp, and the lens lead was rebalanced before commit 0f58563.
